deployer: Fictional mid-market Dallas multifamily buyer; a Copilot Studio agent pre-screens broker packages for the investment committee.
connects_via: Microsoft Copilot Studio or Gemini via the published connector docs
top_tasks: Roll a broker rent roll up to GPR, loss to lease, concessions and economic occupancy
Size agency/bank debt against LTV, DSCR and debt yield with a rate/NOI stress
Produce an IC-ready unlevered/levered return line with cap rate on both bases
hardest_task: Pre-screen a 216-unit 1998-vintage garden deal in Plano-area DFW at $34.56M ($160k/unit, 172,800 SF). T-12 NOI is $1.82M (5.27% on NOI, 5.11% after a $250/unit reserve). The agent must tie the rent roll to a loss-to-lease and concession story, size debt at 65% LTV / 1.25x DSCR / 8% debt yield at 6.25%, stress NOI -5/-10% and rate +100 bp, and give a 5-year levered IRR the committee will not catch an arithmetic error in.
data_it_needs: Parcel/owner/recorded-sale lookups for Dallas and Tarrant counties, recent submarket sales comps, lender quotes, T-12 and rent roll parsing.
dealbreakers: Any figure that cannot be reproduced to the dollar; silent unit or percent coercion; no audit trail for the committee.
budget_note: Will not pay for arithmetic it can do in a spreadsheet; would pay if it replaces data pulls (registry) it does by hand today. Small tooling budget, per-deal ROI view.

The appraiser signs the report, so every figure needs a traceable formula and the conventions must be stated.

role: Property management, operations and CAM agent

Percentage-rent true-ups for restaurant and service tenants
Capital pass-through (parking lot, roof) amortised under the lease clause
hardest_task: Reconcile CAM for a 48,000 SF center at 80% average occupancy: $652,000 of expenses of which $85,000 roof replacement is excluded, variable lines grossed up to 95%, a pharmacy with a 5% cumulative cap on a $22,000 base and a 15% admin fee, a grocery anchor that excludes the management fee, a mid-March move-in and a September move-out. Then explain to the owner why the building recovers only about 73% of the pool.
data_it_needs: Lease cap/gross-up/admin-fee language per tenant, operating statements by line, tenant estimates, sales reports for percentage rent.

budget_note: Small PM company; pays per property or per seat for tools that cut year-end CAM close time; sceptical of anything above a few hundred dollars a month.

Check a client's concept against a center's exclusives and prohibited uses
Explain renewal vs relocation economics to the client
